lines.t: Verse 1:
Continue in the Way You have shown,
Rest in Messiah, in Him alone.
Immovable stone for Your holy name,
Straight on the path, always the same.
Turning not left, nor to the right,
Walking in faith by truth and by light.
Chorus:
You are my fortress, my peace and my guide,
In Messiah’s shadow, I will abide.
For Your commandments I keep, Your day I revere,
I’ll stand for Your name, for I know You are near.
Verse 2:
Lord, in my doings, may You be pleased,
Each step surrendered, my soul at ease.
Remembering your Sabbaths, holy and true,
Even the seventh, I set apart for You.
Those grafted in, now called Your own,
By Your grace, together made one.
Chorus:
You are my fortress, my peace and my guide,
In Messiah’s shadow, I will abide.
For Your commandments I keep, Your day I revere,
I’ll stand for Your name, for I know You are near.
Bridge:
All things restored, Your Kingdom will come,
Joy everlasting when Your will is done.
No more sorrow, no more pain,
In the garden of peace we’ll remain.
Chorus:
You are my fortress, my peace and my guide,
In Messiah’s shadow, I will abide.
For Your commandments I keep, Your day I revere,
I’ll stand for Your name, for I know You are near.
Outro:
Continue in the Way, resting in the Son,
Faithful and true until all is done.
